basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: A managed unit of buildings, systems and grounds under one custody, not a single building.
Defined by operation and lifecycle as a whole, from planning to decommissioning.
Distinct from the site, which is the land and its tenure, and from rooms and equipment inside it.
Its permits and licences are referenced, not owned.

may: Record facility boundaries, custody and operational status from authoritative sources.
Report operational readings and incidents to the facility operator.
Link buildings, systems and spaces that make up the facility.
mustNot: Operate safety-critical systems such as fire, gas or access control without authorization.
Grant or extend site access to people or agents.
Change the recorded operating status or custodian without the operator's decision.
Disclose security layouts, guard routes or vulnerable points.
Hide or delay reporting of environmental releases or safety incidents.
requiresHuman: Approving work under a permit on site.

considerations: Industrial facilities can harm nearby communities through emissions, noise and accidents.
Workers on site depend on accurate hazard and status information.
Surveillance in facilities should be proportionate to safety and security needs.

items: Site area in square metres or hectares within the declared boundary.
Boundary geometry in a declared coordinate reference system with positional accuracy in metres.
Energy consumption in kilowatt hours over a stated period and metering point.
Water use in cubic metres over a stated period.
Occupancy as a count of people present at a stated time.
Sound pressure level in dB(A) at the boundary, with time and measurement position.
A facility is recognised by a fenced or declared boundary, signage, gates and a set of associated buildings and installations.
It is confused with one of its buildings, with the land site and with the operating organization.
Fire, explosion or toxic release from process systems.
Vehicle and pedestrian collisions on site roads.
Failure of shared utilities affecting many users at once.
